RBA issues blunt warning days before next rate decision; higher rates now seen as 'new normal'
Iron ore downside persists, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
Sydney housing market in 'bloodbath' with auction market facing reality check
Super contributions surge >33% post-budget tax changes; digital pension scheme proposed as parallel to compulsory super
Consumer weakness signals: Dollar General CEO flags red flags, Christmas retailer files Chapter 11, discount fashion chain closes 120 stores
WA gold exploration active: Forrestania lands four prefeasibility studies; Great Southern returns 10.72g/t; Larvotto first antimony-gold concentrate
Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire chairman at 96; global 'four horsemen' economic risks flagged

ASX small-cap runners: Latrobe, CurveBeam, Arrow, Sultan

sectors.trend: Iron ore downside persists, pressuring major miners. Gold exploration remains active in WA with Forrestania (four PFS studies), Great Southern (10.72g/t), and Larvotto first antimony-gold concentrate. Bullock hawk rising.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from weak iron ore. Gold juniors (FOR.AX, GSG.AX) and antimony plays (LAR.AX) offer relative strength. Diversify away from iron ore exposure.

sectors.trend: RBA blunt warning ahead of rate decision; higher rates now 'new normal'. Super contributions surge >33% post-budget, boosting fund flows. Digital pension scheme proposed as parallel to compulsory super.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from elevated rate environment but face credit risk from housing stress. Super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPT.AX) see inflow tailwinds. Monitor RBA decision closely.

sectors.trend: Diesel and petrol shock rising, accelerating EV transition. Oil weakness weighs on global equities. EV adoption accelerating as Australians 'flee the bowser'.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WES.AX face margin pressure from fuel price volatility. EV infrastructure and charging plays gain structural tailwind. LNG exporters (WDS.AX) supported by global energy dynamics.

sectors.trend: Consumer confidence deteriorating: Dollar General CEO flags red flags, Christmas retailer files Chapter 11, 80-year discount fashion chain closes 120 stores. Younger Australians face harder wealth path.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX, IAG.AX face consumer spending headwinds. Defensive consumer staples preferred. Discount retail under structural pressure.

sectors.trend: Sydney housing 'bloodbath'; auction market reality check. Fire Labor's housing liars. New rental market disruption via removal of real estate agents.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face occupancy and yield pressure. Property developers (SRG.AX, CGP.AX) under stress. Rental yield compression likely.

sectors.trend: AI sector cooling: Anthropic delays IPO, OpenAI massive cash burn, ASML warning for shareholders. Micron unveils breakthrough memory product. Tesla delivery outlook under pressure.
sectors.implications: Global tech de-risking. ASX tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX) may see reduced sentiment spillover. Micron (MU) positive for memory supply chain. Monitor AI capex cycle.

key_themes: RBA rate decision imminent with hawkish bias; higher-for-longer rates
Iron ore structural weakness pressuring ASX 200 mining weight
Housing market correction in Sydney; auction volumes declining
Consumer spending deterioration across retail and discretionary
Super system reform: surging contributions, digital pension proposal, fitness-for-purpose debate
Geopolitical risk: Trump trade war 'strangling world', four horsemen economic risks
WA gold and antimony exploration remains a bright spot for small-caps
EV transition accelerating amid fuel price shock

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in fixed income; favour floating-rate and short-duration credit. Hedge equity beta with ^AXJO puts.
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold (GSG.AX, NVC.AX) and antimony (LAR.AX).
Reduce REIT and property developer exposure; favour bank equities with strong capital buffers (CBA.AX, NAB.AX).
Shift from discretionary (WES.AX, IAG.AX) to staples (WOW.AX, WBC.AX, SGP.AX).
Maintain 10-15% cash allocation; favour domestic-revenue-heavy names; monitor AUD/USD.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fuel price shock / energy transition disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor WDS.AX, WES.AX margins; consider EV infrastructure and charging equity exposure.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight WA gold and antimony juniors
opportunities.rationale: Active exploration pipeline (Forrestania 4 PFS, Great Southern 10.72g/t, Larvotto first concentrate) provides catalysts amid iron ore weakness

opportunities.recommendation: Favour large-cap banks on rate tailwind
opportunities.rationale: Higher-for-longer rate environment supports NIM; super contribution surge boosts fund flows; CBA and NAB best capitalised
Fuel shock accelerating EV adoption; charging infrastructure and battery supply chain gain structural demand
Latrobe, CurveBeam, Arrow, Sultan showing relative strength; potential rotation into small-caps as large-caps lag

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore downside persists; Sydney housing in bloodbath with auction reality check; both sectors face structural headwinds
Consumer weakness across retail (Chapter 11, store closures, Dollar General warning) favours staples over discretionary

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash buffer ahead of RBA decision
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA blunt warning days before rate decision; hawkish surprise risk to equities and bonds simultaneously

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure into RBA decision. Oil weakness and bond yields cap upside. Iron ore drag on miners. Housing stress weighs on financials and REITs. Gold juniors and banks offer relative strength. Expect volatility around rate announcement.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift toward higher-for-longer rates, EV transition, and super system reform. Iron ore structural decline favours gold and critical minerals. Consumer spending normalisation will take time. Geopolitical trade war adds uncertainty. Productivity concerns (Intergenerational Report) suggest slower growth path.

WA gold exploration results (Forrestania, Great Southern)

AI capex cycle (ASML, Micron, OpenAI burn)
